description.value: Buddy's Pizzeria has been making hand-stretched artisan pizzas on Kaslo's Front Street since 2011, earning the top spot on TripAdvisor for places to eat in Kaslo. It is a licensed, family-owned restaurant run by owners Aaron and Cathy, known for live music, local and organic ingredients, and a relaxed atmosphere. Cyclists crossing on the Balfour ferry can order ahead so their meal is ready on arrival.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and provides address (417 Front St, Kaslo, BC), phone (250-353-2282), and operational details. The About Us subpage contains a stale seasonal closure notice ('currently closed and will reopen again April 13, 2023') that is over three years past and not reflected on the main page or pre-enrichment flags — treated as an outdated widget rather than evidence of permanent closure. The website name ('Buddy's Pizzeria') and OSM name ('Buddy's Front Street Pizzeria') differ slightly; address and phone are confirmed only from the website as OSM has no contact fields. Takeout is confirmed by the order-ahead mention for Balfour ferry arrivals.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Buddy's Front Street Pizzeria' but website consistently uses 'Buddy's Pizzeria' (copyright footer spells it 'Buddy's Pizzaria').

About Us subpage contains a stale seasonal closure notice: 'We are currently closed and will reopen again April 13, 2023.' This date is over three years past and does not appear on the main page; treated as an unremoved seasonal widget, not evidence of permanent closure. Worth a manual check.
OSM has no address or phone; both extracted from website only — contact_confirmed fields reflect no OSM baseline to compare against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating artisan pizza restaurant in Kaslo with an active website and confirmed address and phone; no evidence of permanent closure.
